notes.title: 2100 Large Third Patch!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We are very thankful for your patience with us as we work through the bugs that 2100 has. This is our third patch which includes a huge number of fixes!

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-Added mission text so you know what you are supposed to be doing

-Removed the lit up keypads as it could cause confusion as to where to enter the code

-The player starting position has slightly been changed (so its in accordance with the audio at the start for the door keypad)

-Light has been added to the "The Escape" level so you know where to go instead of aimlessly wandering around and not knowing what to do

-Added a blue light to the first keypad so you know where to go faster

-Extended the collider for the command center level (this will help you progress to the next level)

-Made a door opened from previously closed

-Made a door locked (it was open but supposed to be locked so you can progress)

-Added a red light to the "The Escape" level, which should help you get into the station faster

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: 2100 Second Patch!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is a small patch which fixes/adds some features in 2100!

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-When the text appears for the instructions, a name is added next to it (so you know who is saying it)

-Audio has been fixed on the first level where the instructions were not being said

-Where you have to find the valve, a light has been placed on it so its easier to see (it was previously in the dark and hard to see)

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: 2100 Patch!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

This is the first patch for 2100 which addresses issues experienced on launch.

[h1]Fixes:    [/h1]

-Text now appears for when instructions are given and an access code is involved

-Two doors which led into space have now been fixed

-All keypads should now have lights on them, so you can see which numbers you are entering more easily

-The decompression chamber handle has been slightly moved as it could leave the door behind you open

-The level "The Escape Part 2" audio has been changed. A new part to the story has also been added to this level.

[b]Note: We are looking into why the save game button is not working[/b]

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Patch soon!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We will be updating 2100 with a patch soon to address some issues that have been experienced.

[h1]What will be included:    [/h1]

-Door opening into space at the back of the station will be fixed

-We will look into making text appear on the screen when given instructions. This should make it easier to follow what is been said. We have decided it will be better to make the text appear when given codes for doors, otherwise the screen will have too much text on it.

-Light will be on all keypads so you can see what numbers you are entering

We thank you for all your support on launch!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]
